title: The existence of solutions of Schrödinger equations with essence resonance
summary: The current paper investigates a class of asymptotically linear Schrodinger equations. The Palais-Smale condition fails to hold in this case. Especially under the hypothesis (V2), the lack of compactness occurs at the interaction between nonlinear term and continuum spectrum. For this reason, we introduce a bootstrap iteration approach for elliptic equation on RN. The iteration is self-contained and can be regarded as a generalization of Agmon-Douglis-Nirenberg theorem.
